notes:
TV 1.28 (29) and Mobile 1.16 (17)

Fix Bluetooth host discovery with Android 7.1 / Fire TV. The scanner now reads both older and modern advertising formats while still requiring the BubuTV service identifier.

Prepare Bluetooth is now step 0 on both devices. Searches report when no hosts were found, and the last completed or interrupted result stays visible after leaving and returning to the test screen.

TV: Admin > Settings > Connection > Bluetooth test > Prepare Bluetooth > Host test.
Phone: Bluetooth test > Prepare Bluetooth > Find hosts, match the TV code, Connect > Send test.
Keep both test screens open; the host window is two minutes and a search lasts ten seconds.

This remains a Bluetooth capability ping test, not playback control or authenticated pairing. Physical Pixel 8 / Fire TV roundtrip confirmation remains pending.
